pwa.iosInstructionsBody: Tap the Share icon in Safari's toolbar, then choose "Add to Home Screen".

hero.body: Wrapture analyzes food characteristics and storage conditions, recommends the best-fit packaging material, and predicts shelf life and sustainability impact — all explained in plain language, never a black box.
hero.finePrint: No credit card. Sign in with Google or GitHub in seconds.

flow.heading: How Wrapture thinks
flow.subhead: Five steps from raw food properties to a packaging decision you can defend.
flow.step1Body: Moisture, fat, pH, and respiration rate.
flow.step2Body: 8 scoring dimensions weigh every material against those properties.
flow.step3Body: A ranked shortlist with a transparent breakdown of why each fits.
flow.step4Body: A temperature-adjusted estimate using Q10 kinetics.
flow.step5Body: Recyclability and compostability, scored alongside fit.

materials.footnote: A sample of the 13 materials in our database. Figures are sourced directly from packaging_materials.json.

simulation.footnote: Captured from a real recommend_detailed() run for mango. Numbers may shift slightly as the dataset and model evolve — this page doesn't call the live API.

impact.heading: Why smarter packaging matters
impact.reduceWasteBody: Packaging matched to a commodity's real moisture and respiration profile extends usable shelf life instead of shortening it.
impact.improveSelectionBody: Move past guesswork — every recommendation comes with the reasoning behind it, not just a material name.
impact.supportSustainabilityBody: Recyclability and compostability are scored alongside fit, so sustainability is never traded away for performance.

cta.heading: Ready to make a smarter packaging decision?

footer.tagline: Rules-based packaging recommendations grounded in explainable reasoning.
footer.copyright: © {{year}} Wrapture. Recommendations are generated from rules and typical literature ranges — validate before production use.

recommend.advancedHelp: Overrides the storage-type/slider values above with exact numbers. Commodity property data (moisture, fat, pH, etc.) isn't user-editable — it's looked up server-side per commodity, with confidence shown above.

library.heading: Packaging material library
library.subhead: All 13 packaging materials in our database, with the same barrier data, cost tier, and recyclability rating used in every recommendation. No account needed.

sustainability.heading: Sustainability
sustainability.subhead: A summary of the sustainability scores across your saved recommendations.
sustainability.emptyDescription: Save a recommendation to see your sustainability summary here.
sustainability.explainerBody: Each material's sustainability score (0-100) comes from its recyclability and compostability rating — materials that are widely recyclable curbside or industrially compostable score highest, and multi-material laminates that are hard to separate score lowest. If you prioritize sustainability on a request, this score is weighted more heavily in the overall recommendation.

traceability.heading: Traceability
traceability.subhead: Every saved report's QR code and public verification link, in one place.
traceability.explainer: Scanning a report's QR code — or opening its verification link — opens a public page confirming this exact recommendation exists and showing its key specs (material, barrier properties, sustainability score). Anyone with the link can view it, no Wrapture account required — useful for sharing with a supply-chain partner or auditor.
traceability.emptyDescription: Save a recommendation to get a QR code and shareable verification link for it.
